ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) across central lobes and 25% low-intensity (black) concentrated at the trailing edges, distal tips, and central hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white regions occupying the medial fluke surfaces. Dark pigment bands border the entire trailing edge. A concentrated dark, mottled pigment region is visible at the central hinge extending outward along the lower interior margin of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels. Jagged peaks are most prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer boundary of both lobes, transitioning into a gull-wing arc toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear disruptions. Left lobe: three prominent vertical-diagonal rake marks. Right lobe: one distinct horizontal scratch in the lower-medial quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable linear rake marks across the ventral surface of both lobes. Significant irregular texture and potential tissue erosion at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Parallel vertical linear scarring pattern specifically isolated to the mid-section of the left lobe.
